messages:
tara: Morning — quick async handoff from eng sprint to marketing for the launch content. TL;DR: need final hero image + confirmation on benchmark numbers. I’ll do a short what I did / blockers / today format to keep this tidy.

sam: Got it. I merged the feature-flag PR last night. CI passed. Will share perf numbers in a sec.

deploy-bot: CI ✅ branch feature/benchmarking deployed to staging: https://staging.redwood.example/bench

jess: Quick check — do we lead with 1k RPS or the p95 latency? Current draft leans latency.

michelle: Prefer latency angle. p95 = ~120ms on AMD tests, ~160ms on older GPUs. I can attach a short blurb.

omar: Blocked on hero image from design — pinged @design ~2h ago. If no asset by noon PT can we use a placeholder screenshot?

tara: Placeholder is okay if it shows console + trace. Sam, can you export a clean trace screenshot from staging?

sam: Yep — capturing from staging now. Will strip overlays and supply two sizes (hero + thumbnail).

michelle: Draft tweet copy: `Redwood Inference delivers p95 serving latency ~120ms for 1k RPS. Ship faster, cost lower.` Thoughts?

jess: Tweak suggestion: `p95 inference latency ~120ms at 1k RPS` — shorter and clearer.

michelle: Updated: `p95 inference latency ~120ms at 1k RPS — production-ready inference that scales.`

sam: Submitted CR for the benchmarking artifact so marketing can link to the repo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/benchmarks/pull/89

tara: Blocker: legal asked for permission to use partner logo in the benchmark post. @michelle can you get sign-off?

michelle: On it — I emailed partner legal, expect reply by EOD. If no reply we'll remove the logo.

omar: Also FYI there's a small regression in the sample app UI that might affect screenshots (button overlap). Low priority but I'll file a PR.

sam: Filing PR now and adding a `--screenshot-clean` flag in the test harness so CI generates a clean frame for marketing.

eng-oncall-bot: Notice: Incident 2026-11-05 resolved — no impact on staging.

jess: Plan for today: michelle finalizes copy + chase legal, sam supplies screenshot + benchmark link, omar fixes UI, tara assembles publish checklist and schedules a slot for Friday.

tara: Timeline: aim to publish Friday 10:00 AM PT. If legal doesn't respond by Thu 5:00 PM PT we'll remove the partner logo and proceed.

michelle: Morning update: finalize copy and legal ping. Blockers: partner legal reply. Afternoon: coordinate with design on hero.

sam: Morning: export screenshot + merge CR. Blockers: none. Afternoon: attach artifact to post and QA links.

omar: Morning: file UI fix PR (small CSS tweak). Blockers: none. Afternoon: review screenshot for pixel-perfect.

jess: LGTM. I'll do a quick editorial pass once copy + screenshot are in this thread. :thumbsup:

tara: Thanks team. If anything urgent, ping here and mark with `!urgent` so it surfaces. I'll update the checklist as we get assets.
